name: deep-research
description: Gathers sources from web and academic channels, evaluates quality, then synthesizes a structured research report with citations

agents.name: web-researcher
agents.prompt: Search the web for relevant sources on the given topic

agents.name: academic-searcher
agents.prompt: Search academic and technical sources on the given topic

agents.name: source-evaluator
agents.prompt: Evaluate all gathered sources for relevance, credibility, and recency

agents.name: report-synthesizer
agents.prompt: Synthesize the top-scored sources into a structured research report
